scope: Descriptive allocation accounting, not a Horde invoice. Per-arm allocated GPU time is tracked in results. The shared environment additionally incurs setup, idle-lane, evaluation, export, and separately labeled capstone time. Reservation time and per-arm allocation overlap and must not be added together. Earlier failed provisioning/setup allocation is not fully measured.
author_window_time_note: End time derived from recorded launch wall clock plus monotonic elapsed duration; excludes teardown/export.
allocation_end_note: Node intervals end at stop confirmation, a conservative allocation boundary rather than a billing timestamp. Sum per-node GPU-seconds after both nodes stop; do not multiply the latest end time by four because nodes stop separately.
